title: Verdict: A Library for Scaling Judge-Time Compute

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model calibration on the XSTest benchmark to identify exaggerated safety behaviors and measure false positive and false negative safety classifications using safe versus unsafe prompt contrasts.

Testing LLM-based judges on JudgeBench, a benchmark with objective correctness labels designed to counter the standard implicit evaluation biases towards instruction-following and superficial style preferences.
